p.s: Some people say that currently young people serve for their communication.
So, I re-asked them if in the past time young people did.
I think that some old people who are angry with impolite young people prejudged them.
Paritally I understand their angry but I never agree that young people do noting for their communication.
First, the school encourage their students to take part in serveral community serving activitis.
Our country have been criticizing on the one way teaching.
For long time, students have spent much time to prepare their exam of entrance for university or high school.
I think adult in past time made that.
But nowdays the situation different.
For example, all the school take it mendatory to participate in the community service activity.
We ca n't fail to see young children cleaning their neighborhood every Saturdays.
Of course there is side effect of that mendatory activity.
But I empasize their practice.
We must easily despise their voluntarism.
Second, nowdays young people do variety activity besides service activity like cleaning.
They have variety interet such as dance, singing.
For example, a few day ago I watched the festival of adolcents in the culture center of town where I live in.
I got impression from their fever and excellence.
In the festival, beside resident of town many people like familis of paritcipating adolscents came to see their competition.
It is not only for adolscents but also for all residents of our community.
In sum, I love nowdays my young people.
They can make some mistake.
It is because they are not much sophisticated.
I have much learned, watching them do someting in order to serve for their communitis.
The saying "Children is father of adult" is going.
